This repository distributes the Zoho Flow On-Prem Extension SDK, not the Zoho Flow Agent implementation. Java is the only currently available language. Use "On-Prem Extension" consistently in customer-facing prose. Follow `AGENTS.md`, `sdk/java/docs/java-api.md`, and the closest relevant SDK guide. Compile against `ZohoFlow-extension-sdk.jar` and `json.jar`, but never package those JARs in an Extension upload ZIP. Do not invent Python or Node.js support, undocumented SDK APIs, Agent compatibility ranges, or finalized licensing terms.
